{{Quote|We are merchants, not conquerors.|Hath Monchar, to [[Jurnel Arrant]]|<ref name="Darth Maul: Saboteur">"[[Darth Maul: Saboteur]]"</ref>}}
'''Hath Monchar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Deputy Viceroy]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]], between the years [[33 BBY/Legends|33]] and [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Though initially one of [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]'s key advocates, he eventually betrayed both the conglomerate and its concealed ally, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], by foolishly attempting to sell information on their schemes to the highest bidder, a folly that would inevitably cost Monchar his life.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Sith have returned. They mean to use the Trade Federation for the blockade of&hellip; a certain planet. But I believe it is part of a much larger plan. This information&hellip; The details&hellip; This is what I offer you. For a price, of course.|Hath Monchar, to [[Darnada]]|<ref name="Darth Maul 2 (2000)">[[Darth Maul (2000) 2|''Darth Maul'' (2000) 2]]</ref>}}
In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Hath Monchar, alongside the like-minded [[Settlement Officer/Legends|Settlement Officer]] [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]] and [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]], had been welcomed into the small inner circle of [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] and was thus one of the very few to be aware of the shady pact between the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]]. Together with the mysterious [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], Monchar and his peers conspired to ensure Gunray's ascension as sole head of their organization, which would allow them in turn to strengthen their own positions as the latter's prime supporters.

During this time, Monchar became aware of two [[Lommite Limited]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] being sabotaged by its immediate rival on [[Dorvalla]], [[InterGalactic Ore]], resulting in their destruction in the former company's property. He offered his "sympathy" to LL's [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]], [[Jurnel Arrant]], as well as the Federation's service in [[Lommite/Legends|lommite]] transportation. Jurnel refused, stating that he would contact Monchar on "some later date", not the other way around. Later on, LL and InterGal merged into [[Dorvalla Mining]], giving shipping and [[Ore/Legends|ore]] allocation to the Federation. Monchar believed he would be rewarded for the part he played in this matter, but Darth Sidious ordered Gunray to dismiss him while they conferred in private; Gunray, fearing the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]'s wrath, had no choice but to comply.

Following the deaths of the members of the [[Trade Federation Directorate]] untraceably orchestrated by Sidious, Gunray became the unquestioned leader of the organization and placed Monchar and his other associates in the vacant seats of power. Later, however, the Deputy Viceroy would grow dissatisfied with the Federation's gullible gradual adherence to the dictates of the Sith and seemingly how it morphed their business into a war machine. Monchar ultimately betrayed Sidious and Gunray when he fled the latter's flagship, [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']], with a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] storing intel about the upcoming [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], foolishly hoping to make a fortune by selling it to the highest bidder.

Monchar attempted to sell the holocron to [[Darnada]], a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]], in the [[Deep Space Demolition and Removal]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. Though granted an audience, the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] laughed him off, disbelieving the Neimoidian's claims. Luckily for Monchar, he left Darnada immediately before Darth Sidious's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], arrived to slaughter Darnada and his entire operation except [[Asa Naga]], who managed to escape and warn [[Alexi Garyn]] of the assassin - all part of another concurrent scheme of Darth Sidious.

[[32 BBY/Legends|Weeks or months after the incident]], Monchar went into hiding on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he attempted to sell the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] to information broker [[Lorn Pavan]], sending him a message and requesting that they meet at the [[Dewback Inn]]. When Lorn came before him and his bodyguard, a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] named [[Gorth (Trandoshan)|Gorth]], the Neimoidian revealed the nature of the valuable commodity he was in possession of and demanded that the former come at his cubicle in one hour to pay him 500,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], or else he would find a more generous bidder.

The former Deputy Viceroy's treachery did not go unobserved, and it attracted attention from both the Trade Federation and the Sith, both parties trying to retrieve the holocron and prevent him from spilling their secret plans. To this end, Sidious sent Maul to track and hunt down Monchar as well as any of his contacts, therefore tying up all loose ends.

In the hopes of silencing Monchar before Sidious could discover the turncoat, Nute Gunray had Rune Haako hire [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mahwi Lihnn|Mawhi Lhinn]] to apprehend the rogue Neimoidian. Unknown to the two sniveling dignitaries, Darth Maul had finally tracked the ex-Deputy Viceroy to his [[Kaldani Spires Residential Apartments|domicile]], where he proceeded to slaughter Gorth and two [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] henchmen, before [[Sai cha/Legends|beheading]] Monchar himself while suspending him in the air with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] - ultimately the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith Warrior|Sith warrior]] would complete his mission and recover the holocron for his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]].

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|How is it that whenever tragedy strikes, the first ones I hear from are the Neimordians."''<br>''"We are a compassionate species."''<br/>''"''Compassionate'' and ''Neimoidian'' don't belong in the same sentence, Monchar.|Jurnel Arrant and Hath Monchar|<ref name="Darth Maul: Saboteur" />}}
Like many of his kind, Hath Monchar was greedy and power-hungry, traits highly sought by Nute Gunray with whom he ingratiated himself, becoming one of the latter's closest underlings. He was not above throwing in with Darth Sidious to advance both his superior's and his own career, although only half-heartedly being as apprehensive of this mysterious ally similar to his colleagues. Though the Neimoidians' collaboration with their Sith patron yielded profitable results, Monchar would eventually turn on both Sidious and Gunray in an attempt to enrich himself through selling the holocron; he also claimed that he thought that members of his species were not supposed to be conquerors, but humble and successful traders. But Monchar was naive as well, for in spite of witnessing the extent of Sidious' grasp with the demise of the Trade Federation's governing board he honestly believed he could get away without suffering the consequences of earning the Dark Lord's ire.
